cadence: Monthly, on the first day of the month

paths.title: Build with Kiro and today’s models
paths.description: A guided route from Kiro fundamentals to a Bedrock-powered agent you can secure, deploy, and evaluate.

steps.label: Get comfortable with Kiro
steps.rationale: Start with Kiro’s spec-driven workflow so you can plan and steer the build before adding model and agent complexity.

steps.label: Build with Bedrock, Kiro, and agent tools
steps.rationale: Connect Kiro to Bedrock and learn how Strands and AgentCore fit into an agent-building workflow.

steps.label: Add safety checks
steps.rationale: Put responsible-use controls in place before exposing a generative AI application to users.

steps.label: Run an agent with AgentCore
steps.rationale: Move from a local prototype to the managed runtime and services used to operate agents on AWS.

steps.label: Evaluate and observe the result
steps.rationale: Finish with evaluation and observability so you can measure quality and diagnose production behavior.
